parts: how do i link my fb book bsuiness page to my instagram bsuiness page and add a book now button

Here’s a step-by-step guide to linking your **Facebook Business Page** to your **Instagram Business Profile** and adding a **“Book Now”** button:  

---

### **Step 1: Make sure your Instagram account is a Business account**
1. Open the **Instagram app**.  
2. Go to your profile → tap the **three lines** (☰) → **Settings** → **Account** → **Switch to Professional Account** → choose **Business**.  

---

### **Step 2: Link Instagram to your Facebook Page**
1. On Instagram:
   - Go to **Settings** → **Business** → **Connect a Facebook Page**.  
   - Select the Facebook Page you want to link.  
2. On Facebook:
   - Go to your **Page Settings** → **Instagram** → **Connect Account**.  
   - Log in to Instagram and confirm linking.  

> **Tip:** You must be an **admin** of the Facebook Page to link it.

---

### **Step 3: Add the “Book Now” button**
1. On Facebook:
   - Go to your **Business Page** → click **Add a Button** (below your cover photo) → select **Book Now**.  
   - Choose a booking service: you can either use **Facebook’s own booking system** (Meta appointments) or **link to your external booking provider** (like Calendly, Acuity, or your MedSpa software).  

2. On Instagram:
   - Go to your profile → tap **Edit Profile** → **Action Buttons** → choose **Book Now**.  
   - Connect it to the same booking service you used on Facebook.  

---

✅ Once done, users can click **Book Now** on both Instagram and Facebook, and your accounts will be linked so posts and ads can be shared seamlessly.
